question.text: A deuteron and a proton moving with equal kinetic energy enter into to a uniform magnetic field at right angle to the field. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>d</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></math> are the radii of their circular paths respectively, then the ratio <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>d</mi></msub><msub><mi>r</mi><mi>p</mi></msub></mfrac></math> will be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msqrt><mi>x</mi></msqrt><mo>:</mo><mn>1</mn></math> where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is _____ .

solution.text:
As we know, radius of circular path followed by charged particle under perpendicular magnetic field is given by,

R=mvqB and KE=12mv2

Therefore,

⇒R=2mKEqB  Then, R∝mq

⇒RdRp=mdmp×qpqd=21×11=2:1

Thus, x=2.
